name: Anchor Browser MCP
summary: Anchor's hosted MCP servers give agents isolated cloud browsers with stealth, captcha solving, managed logins and saved automations.
description: Three servers on one account: `Anchor` (https://api.anchorbrowser.io/v1/mcp, start here), `Anchor Browser` (live browser control) and `Anchor Actions` (per-site verified actions). Sign in via OAuth or send an API key header; the legacy https://api.anchorbrowser.io/mcp still works with `anchor-api-key`.
